🍷 WE ARE HIRING – CASHIER | GOOD TIME WINE STORE 🍷

Good Time Wine Store is looking for a motivated and responsible Male Cashier to join our team!

📍 Preferred Candidates: Quepem, Curchorem, Sanguem, Cuncolim and nearby areas.

✅ Requirements:
• B.Com Graduate
• Good knowledge of liquor brands, types and pricing
• Cash handling and POS system experience
• Basic to advanced knowledge of Tally
• Valid 2-wheeler and 4-wheeler driving licences
• Own vehicle required
• Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays

💰 Salary Details:
• 1st Month: ₹20,000
• From 2nd Month Onwards: ₹20,000 + ₹5,000 incentive
• Total: ₹25,000 in hand (including incentive)

📅 Weekly Off: Monday
⚠️ No emergency off on Saturdays and Sundays.

📩 Send your resume:
Email: goodtime6500@gmail.com
WhatsApp: 7038304151
